page.title: Immutability
page.desc: Values that never change after creation; updates produce new values. Removes whole classes of bugs and makes sharing across threads safe.
page.intro: Values that never change after creation; updates produce new values. Removes whole classes of bugs and makes sharing across threads safe.

synapses.text: Structural sharing lets an "updated" tree reuse most of the old one, so immutability is not a copy of everything every time.
If nothing mutates, there is nothing to race on; immutability is the simplest concurrency strategy.

parent.title: Functional programming
parent.desc: Programs as compositions of functions: first-class functions, immutability and pure functions, rooted in Alonzo Church's lambda calculus of the 1930s.
